items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento allows an attacker to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without user interaction. This flaw has been exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: A critical security update addresses a code injection vulnerability (StyleSmuggler) that allows unauthenticated remote code execution and has been actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could result in security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: Adobe released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, and arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities, which if exploited, could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.

items.title: SessionReaper: Unauthenticated RCE in Magento & Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical flaw, publicly known as SessionReaper, allows customer account takeover and unauthenticated remote code execution under certain conditions, with mass attacks observed in the wild.

items.title: CosmicSting: XML external entity injection in the REST API
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, also known as CosmicSting, allows an unauthenticated attacker to read arbitrary files and, when chained with another bug, execute code, leading to mass exploitation.

items.title: Unrestricted upload of a file with a dangerous type
items.summary: This vulnerability allows arbitrary code execution by an unauthenticated attacker, specifically affecting merchants using the Apache web server for on-premises or self-hosted deployments.
